title: Chapter 332 Achieving Eternal Life
content:
Chapter 332 Achieving Eternal Life

They never thought that there would be someone in this world who would be so bold that even their Palace of Void would dare to frame them.

Before, Lu Daosheng went to their Void Palace, but he, the master of Void Palace, was almost killed.

Thinking of this, Xu Wuzi was in anger.

This damn ant.

"Get up."

As Lu Daosheng spoke lightly.

The powerful people in the Void Palace dared to slowly get up.

They were so awe of Lu Daosheng that in addition to Lu Daosheng's terrifying and unfathomable strength, they also had warnings from Lord Venerable.

When meeting this person, you must be respectful.

It can be imagined that the person in front of you is an existence that even the Venerable Master must pay attention to.

At this time, a woman rushed out of the crowd of the Void Palace and headed straight towards Chen Yu, who was sitting on the ground in the distance, regardless of everything.

Seeing this scene, Xu Wuzi's face changed drastically, and he quickly shouted, "Songyue doesn't want it!"

However, at this time the woman had already lost her mind when facing Chen Yu.

To be precise, it was when she learned that her own brother was framed, that she was already close to the brink of madness.

"You damn ant, you killed my brother. I want to make you worse than death!!"

A shrill roar sounded from Song Yue's mouth.

The next moment, Chen Yu's screams rang out from the field.

Facing Song Yue from the Palace of Void, Chen Yu naturally had no power to resist.

Although he is now surging on the other side of the starry sky, he can be said to be above millions of people.

But facing the orderly forces of the Void Palace, they can only be considered a bigger ant at most.

Seeing Chen Yu in front of him constantly being tortured by Song Yue.

Xu Wuzi's face was sweating, and he glanced carefully at Lu Daosheng on the side from time to time, for fear that Lu Daosheng would be angry.

After all, even if they hated this person any longer, the right to deal with this person is still in Lu Daosheng's hands.

Without Lu Daosheng's approval, how dare they take action?

"grown ups,,"

Xu Wuzi was nervous.

Lu Daosheng waved his hand.

He also understood Song Yue very well. After all, his own brother was tragically injured because of other people's frame-up, and anyone who put him would lose his mind.

However, sympathy is sympathy, Lu Daosheng will naturally not forget the fact that Songzhe insulted and intimidated himself.

This is also the reason why he knows that he has wrongly accused Songzhe but has not taken any measures.

"alright."

Lu Daosheng spoke gently.

The voice suddenly seemed to have magic power attached, which made Song Yue, who had already red eyes in the distance, calm down.

"Bring him here."

"Yes, sir."

Soon, Chen Yu, who was already dying and had no intact place on his body, was thrown in front of Lu Daosheng and the others by the people from the Palace of Void.

At this moment, Chen Yu's eyes were even blinded by Song Yue, which shows Song Yue's hatred for Chen Yu.

Looking at Chen Yu in front of him, Lu Daosheng was silent for a moment and slowly poked out his right hand.

The next moment, a mysterious force poured into Chen Yu's body from Lu Daosheng's hands.

In a moment, a magical scene appeared.

Chen Yu's injuries suddenly recovered as before, and even his eyes quickly recovered from light.

Seeing this scene, everyone present was puzzled.

Why do you want to save him?

At this moment, only Chen Yu himself knew what Lu Daosheng was doing.

Chen Yu's first words after "recovering" were roaring: "Kill me, kill me!"

That's right, Chen Yu had not recovered at this moment, and the injuries on his body were still unforgettable. What Lu Daosheng did was just to make Chen Yu look recovered, but in fact, he was just breathing a sigh of relief.

Doing this not only caused Chen Yu torture, but also could not even die.

"Want to die? Hehe, you know, you should thank me now."

Lu Daosheng looked at Chen Yu and smiled slightly.

Just a little creepy smile.

Hearing Lu Daosheng's words, Chen Yu trembled all over.

I heard Lu Daosheng continue, "In a sense, I have allowed you to achieve eternal life."

"Because as long as I am immortal, you will live in endless pain forever."

Lu Daosheng's voice kept echoing from Chen Yu's ears.

At this moment, Chen Yu was completely ashamed and kept murmuring, "No, no, no.."

What unifies the other side of the starry sky and what becomes supreme? Now he just wants to die.

"Lingyun, let's go."

Lu Daosheng rolled up the limp Chen Yu with one hand and headed towards the depths of the other side of the starry sky with Yan Lingyun.

In place, the people in the Palace of Void looked at each other and were at a loss.

After a moment of silence, Xu Wuzi pulled the lost Song Yue and followed Lu Daosheng with peace of mind.

Seeing this, everyone hurriedly followed.

At this time, there was also a huge change on the other side of the starry sky.

Back then, Lu Daosheng ordered the palace master and ancestor of the Dome Heavenly Palace to unify the entire starry sky.

I thought that with the large amount of resources I left behind and the help of the heavenly way on the other side of the starry sky, this thing should go smoothly.

But unexpectedly, Chen Yu's incident happened.

By the way, there is also the Nether Sea.

Chen Yu used the power of the Nether Sea and the energy of the Chen clan on the other side of the starry sky, plus the power of nothingness, to completely sit on the throne of the number one person on the other side of the starry sky.

Now, the Chen clan is at its peak on the other side of the starry sky, while the dome sky is suffering heavy casualties and is facing the danger of being destroyed.

However, all this turned around as Lu Daosheng entered the other side of the starry sky.

In the face of absolute strength, any strategy is meaningless.

Dome Heavenly Palace.

Lu Daosheng came here with Yan Lingyun.

At this moment, the Dome Palace was ruined and silent.

Buzz —

At this time, the space trembled.

The next moment, a familiar figure appeared in the direction in front of Lu Daosheng.

"The Lord of the Palace of the Dome Heavenly Palace, Lang Hai, has seen the Lord."

The breath of the waves was sluggish, but he still bowed respectfully to Lu Daosheng.

Looking at the embarrassing palace master of the Dome Heavenly Palace in front of me, the former spirit was gone, but the wrinkles on his face were increasing.

God didn't know how much pressure he was carrying the Dome Palace to this day.

You should know that on the other side of the starry sky, most forces have surrendered to Chen Yu.

"Thanks for your hard work."

Although Langhai did not fulfill Lu Daosheng's expectations, he at least worked hard.

It's just bad luck.

Hearing Lu Daosheng's words, Langhai could no longer suppress it, and his whole body trembled and his eyes were red.

"alright."

Lu Daosheng waved his hand gently, and a gentle energy surged into the sea of waves.

In just a moment, Langhai immediately recovered as before.

Even the deep-rooted injuries are no exception.

"Thank you sir!"

Lang Hai looked very happy and thanked him repeatedly.

At this time, Lu Daosheng asked, "How many people are left in your Dome Heavenly Palace now?"

Hearing this, Lang Hai was slightly stunned and waved to the back.

The next moment, dozens of figures flew out from the dome heavenly palace and descended behind Langhai.

"We've seen the adults."
